sentences.text: Researchers investigated how transient electrical connections are eliminated as neural circuits mature by examining the PLM mechanosensory neurons of the worm Caenorhabditis elegans.

A genetic screen identified the UNC-51 kinase as necessary for removing these temporary links, a process where the UNC-51 protein modifies UNC-76 to transport and remove innexin proteins that build electrical synapses; when this pathway fails, electrical synapses remain active and neurons become overly excited.
The authors suggest this mechanism provides a general model for how temporary electrical links are removed during development.
